title: Lorraine Motel
visualBrief: Preserved courtyard-facing motel frontage, angled connecting bays and short return, mint doors, cream curtains, balcony panels, room 306 wreath, exterior stairs and freestanding Googie sign.

appearance.colorEncoding: sRGB palette decoded to linear COLOR_0

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Signed front platform reference [0,8], source terrain retained independently; rear closure foundations extend to -3.8 m for coarse host-terrain relief and frontage platforms to -1.2 m.

terrainReference.basis: Front platform reference on independently preserved host terrain.

geographicProposal.notes: The 42.567 m long frontage follows the two map vertices at the preserved balcony edge. Angled connecting bays and the short return follow the remaining balcony polyline. Modern museum volumes behind the motel are excluded; rear closure depth is interpreted from photographs, not the entire combined museum envelope. Sign position is estimated inside the courtyard from the inspected public-domain street view; it is not a measured control.

limitations: Original medium-fi preserved motel exterior and sign; modern museum envelope, interiors, historic cars and neighboring buildings are outside scope.

Protomaps frontage and separate balcony polygon control location and alignment. Room widths, wall depths, roof heights and sign position are photographic estimates from inspected public-domain views. The museum donor map is excluded from current imagery approval and supplies no geodetic coordinates.

Hidden rear is a simplified attachment surface. Fine sign typography, room numbers, flowers and hardware are simplified. Cleared Qualla and supporting public-domain photographs remain local reference inputs and are not embedded.
Independent coarse host terrain is retained for contact review; it is not a survey. No footprint suppression is requested for the combined museum polygon.
